title: Captain Marvel #4 Marvel 2019 Rogue vs Carol Danvers Amanda Conner Cover
condition_description: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Captain Marvel #4 (Marvel, 2019 series; Legacy #138). Rogue vs. Carol Danvers. Cover by Amanda Conner & Paul Mounts, signed on the art as a homage "after Lee & Williams" (Jim Lee & Scott Williams). Written by Kelly Thompson, art by Carmen Carnero, colors by Tamra Bonvillain. Released April 2019. $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Captain Marvel film and soundtrack ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
